title: Prepare your service desk and open the customer list
goal: Prepare a separate small practice application without BSL or changing the preceding infobase.

prerequisites.text: Create an empty infobase and distinguish Designer from Enterprise mode.

sections.title: Why a prepared configuration is useful
paragraphs: The introductory empty infobase helped identify windows but has no application lists yet. Customer entry requires a catalog definition. Our small original Training service desk supplies Customers, Services and Service request. It includes no real data or third-party application. Writing BSL is unnecessary for the first customer card.

A configuration is not the platform. First install the official training platform from its source; separately download NexusTrainingServiceDeskV2.cf using the lab-guide button. Do not run this file as an installer: load it through Designer into your own infobase.

sections.title: Choose the load target
paragraphs: Only a verified empty target is used.

code.source:
Introductory work → preserve.
Practice → new empty directory → load the original .cf.
code.output: Earlier work remains separate; the new infobase receives the service definition.

sections.title: A new location for the new practice
paragraphs: Create another startup entry without a configuration, name it Training service desk — practice and choose a new separate directory. Do not load into the introductory infobase. Before launch distinguish similar entries by their registered directories; different copies can display the same configuration title.

The .cf contains structure, not every customer from another infobase. Loading it changes the selected application definition. Establish that the target is new and empty first; otherwise cancel and return to the startup list.

sections.title: Load, apply and open
paragraphs: Open Designer from the verified new entry. Select Configuration → Load configuration from file and choose the .cf. Then Update database configuration (usually F7), read the changes and wait. Start Enterprise mode after completion.

Find the Учебная сервисная служба section and Клиенты command; placement can vary with version. Opening the list creates no customer. It is empty in a new infobase. The next lesson creates the first card and verifies it survives reopening.

sections.title: An empty list after setup
paragraphs: The configuration defines records but does not create your customers.

code.source: Customers: 0 rows → create the first card in the next lesson.
code.output: No rows is a normal initial condition.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning
rows: No third-party demonstration dataset is needed.

sections.title: Continue instead of starting over
paragraphs: Each day open the same practice entry. Reloading .cf is not normal continuation and can affect structural edits. Use .dt for data backup and a separate restoration check. Keep a short note identifying your infobase, lesson and next action.

Nexus knows the selected lesson and saved local position, but does not automatically inspect external 1C. For an empty list check the entry, directory and search first. The engineering stand with seeded test records is a separate experiment; its numbers and totals do not replace observations of your new infobase.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: I double-click .cf as an installer. Load it using Designer; install the platform separately.
I reload the template every day. Open the same infobase to continue; loading does not substitute for data saving.

practice.title: A prepared application in a new personal infobase
practice.task: Prepare your practice and explain why an empty customer list can indicate a correctly working application.
practice.environment: Normally installed official training platform and the original .cf linked by Nexus.
practice.externalRoute: Nexus → 1C startup list → Designer → Enterprise mode

steps.title: Obtain the training definition
steps.where: Nexus → How to complete the lab
steps.action: Download Training service desk — configuration, named NexusTrainingServiceDeskV2.cf. Save it in a known directory. Do not unpack .cf or install it as a program.
steps.why: The separate file contains only our original application definition.
steps.expected: The .cf is available and the platform was installed separately.
steps.troubleshooting: If an HTML file or an unknown archive was downloaded, do not rename it to .cf; return to the course link.
steps.before: The training platform is installed and earlier work is preserved. Select a new empty infobase for this practice.

steps.title: Create an empty practice target
steps.action: Create Training service desk — practice without a configuration on this computer in a new directory. Verify its entry and directory before launch.
steps.why: Protect the preceding infobase from loading changes.
steps.expected: Practice has its own new directory.
steps.troubleshooting: For matching names compare directories; never confirm changes in an unidentified infobase.
steps.before: The .cf is available and the platform was installed separately.

steps.title: Load the configuration
steps.action: Choose Load configuration from file and select the downloaded .cf. Answer Yes to Update database configuration if prompted; otherwise run the update (F7). Inspect the changes: Клиенты, Услуги, ЗаявкаУслуги and СтатусыЗаявки are added without deleting earlier objects. Choose Accept and wait.
steps.why: The application must use the loaded definition.
steps.expected: The tree contains Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги and the update completes.
steps.troubleshooting: If your version cannot open the file, preserve work and record the exact version; do not change protection or seek activation bypasses.
steps.before: Practice has its own new directory.

steps.title: Open Customers
steps.action: Open Учебная сервисная служба → Клиенты. Create no cards yet; note the empty starting state.
steps.why: Check the place required by the next exercise.
steps.troubleshooting: A metadata tree means Designer is still open; application lists belong in Enterprise mode.
steps.before: The tree contains Клиенты, Услуги and ЗаявкаУслуги and the update completes.

figures.caption: Open Учебная сервисная служба: Service request, Customers and Services commands are available.
figures.alt: Open Учебная сервисная служба: Service request, Customers and Services commands are available.

figures.caption: The prepared application opens a real empty customer list. Create your first card in the next lesson.
figures.alt: The prepared application opens a real empty customer list. Create your first card in the next lesson.

steps.title: Record how to continue
steps.action: Close your application normally and reopen the same startup entry → Enterprise → Customers. Note that creating the first customer is next.
steps.expected: The list opens again and introductory work remains separate.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not create a new infobase or reload .cf on every return.
